import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    a1, a2, a3 = map(int, input[1:4])
    b1, b2, b3 = map(int, input[4:7])
    
    min_wins = max(0, min(a1 - b2, a2 - b3, a3 - b1) + min(a1 - b3, a2 - b1, a3 - b2))
    max_wins = min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3) + min(a3, b1)
    
    print(min_wins, max_wins)

main()
